edits.old: Then use what you captured. This is where most campus activations quietly fail. The email list sits untouched, the followers never hear from the brand again, the great photos never get repurposed. added_links.anchor: A campus product launch
NIST guidance on limiting and protecting personal data

edits.old: A campus product launch is not just a smaller version of a national launch. Students move through tight social circles, crowded weekly routines, group chats, nightlife plans, club meetings, class schedules, and campus traditions. If your product shows up in the wrong place, students ignore it. If it shows up through the right people at the right moment, it can feel like it belongs.

Ask for the outputs that show real activity: posts and links, event photos, sign-up counts, samples distributed, codes redeemed, and short notes on what students were saying and asking. These are the signals that tell you what happened on the ground, in the students' own words.
